name: ax-extract-workflow
title_zh: 从历史产物反推当时的工作流
tagline_zh: 看到旧成果想不起怎么做的？问它一句，ax 自动翻出当时的会话，按顺序讲清是哪几步 skill 拼出了那个结果。
tagline_en: Staring at an old artifact and can't recall how it got made? Ask once—ax digs up the sessions and narrates the.
desc_en: Reconstruct the workflow behind a past artifact - "what made X work" / "extract workflow from <date|sha>" / "how did we ship Y". Uses ax to find the relevant sessions and narrate the ordered skill arcs that produced the result. Triggers on "what made X work", "how did we build Y", "extract workflow from <date>", "extract workflow from <sha>", "what was the workflow around <topic>", "show me how I
why_zh: 不是搜聊天记录，而是用 ax 的会话索引定位产物对应的时刻，再按时间轴把 skill 调用串成可复述的。
why_en: It doesn't grep chat logs—it uses ax's session index to pin the artifact's moment, then chains skill calls into a narratable.
limit_zh: 只认 ax 已索引的会话；产物若来自未记录的手工操作或外部工具，它只能还原到 skill 调用层，不补缺失步骤。
limit_en: Only works on ax-indexed sessions; if the artifact came from manual or external steps, it stops at skill-call level and won't fill gaps.
